run_PointRend_training: run the PointRend training script with a config file and GPU arguments via command line
run_PointRend_evaluation: run the PointRend model in eval-only mode to test on a dataset and verify results
build_sem_seg_train_aug: build semantic segmentation training augmentations including resize, crop, color aug, and random flip
build_Trainer_evaluator: build an evaluator for coco, lvis, sem_seg, or cityscapes datasets using the Trainer class
build_Trainer_train_loader: build a training data loader with optional semantic segmentation augmentations using the Trainer class
